name: Filtered cigarette
definition: manufactured cigarette of cut tobacco in a paper tube with a filter tip.
notes: cigarettes described with or without a filter; JT lists cigarette brands

name: Plain cigarette
definition: manufactured cigarette with no filter.
notes: page says cigarettes are made with or without a filter

name: Clove cigarette [kretek]
definition: cigarette of tobacco blended with cloves.
notes: tobacco and clove cigarette, filtered or unfiltered

name: Pre-roll
definition: ready-rolled smoke of cannabis or other plant material, including the joint and the pre-rolled blunt.

name: Infused pre-roll
definition: pre-roll whose material is coated or mixed with a concentrate.
notes: Infused Pre Roll: infused blunts, joints, minis

name: Bidi
definition: thin hand-rolled smoke of tobacco wrapped in a leaf and tied with thread (provisional until attested, B-31).
notes: tobacco flake in tendu leaf tied with string; India

name: Corona
definition: the benchmark straight-sided cigar, about 5.5 to 6 inches by ring gauge 42 to 44.

name: Petit corona [Mareva]
definition: short straight-sided corona-gauge cigar.
notes: Habanos factory name Mareva = Petit Corona

name: Corona gorda
definition: corona-length cigar of a thicker gauge.

name: Lonsdale
definition: long, slender straight-sided cigar (provisional until a page shows it, section 14).
notes: about 6.5 in x 42; shown, provisional lifted

name: Robusto
definition: short, thick straight-sided cigar.

name: Toro
definition: medium-long straight-sided cigar of a thick gauge.

name: Churchill [Julieta No. 2]
definition: long straight-sided cigar of a medium-thick gauge.

name: Double corona
definition: very long straight-sided cigar of a thick gauge.

name: Gordo [Grande]
definition: straight-sided cigar of a very large ring gauge.
notes: Cigar Aficionado lists Grande, ring 60+; Holts lists Gordo

name: Panatela
definition: long, thin straight-sided cigar.

name: Lancero
definition: very long, very thin straight-sided cigar.

name: Torpedo [Pyramid, Pirámide]
definition: figurado tapering to a pointed head.
notes: Habanos Piramide = Torpedo; CA treats pyramid and torpedo as near-synonyms

name: Belicoso
definition: figurado with a short tapered, rounded head.
notes: short pyramid with slightly rounded head

name: Perfecto
definition: figurado tapered at both ends, bulging in the middle.
notes: tapered at both ends with bulge

name: Diadema [Salomón]
definition: very large figurado with a tapered head and a closed or tapered foot.
notes: Salomon is a popular diadema size

name: Culebra
definition: three thin cigars braided together and sold as one.
notes: three panetelas braided, sold as one

name: Cigarillo
definition: small, thin cigar.

name: Little cigar
definition: cigarette-sized cigar wrapped in tobacco leaf or leaf-based paper, usually filtered.
notes: little cigars, flavoured; Small Cigars and Filtered Cigars facets

name: Virginia blend
definition: pipe tobacco blend led by Virginia leaf.
notes: Virginia family; Virginia in 171 pipehouse blends

name: Virginia/Perique blend
definition: Virginia-led blend with Perique leaf.

name: Burley-based blend [American blend]
definition: pipe tobacco blend led by Burley leaf (merge with American blend provisional, section 14).
notes: Burley family; American blend alias not shown separately

name: English blend [Balkan]
definition: unflavoured blend with Latakia and oriental leaf.

name: Aromatic blend
definition: pipe tobacco blend flavoured or cased for aroma.
notes: aromatic top note; 112 aromatic blends at pipehouse

name: Fine-cut roll-your-own tobacco
definition: loose finely cut tobacco sold for hand-rolling or filling tubes.
notes: JT sells hand-rolling tobacco; hand-rolled form described

name: Kizami [kizami]
definition: Japanese very fine-cut tobacco leaf for the kiseru (regional kind, C11; provisional until attested in a second region).
notes: kizami for kiseru; only Japan shown

name: Flower
definition: dried cannabis flower sold loose.
notes: Flower: bud, big buds, smalls, ground

name: Kratom powder
definition: dried and ground kratom leaf, the dried leaf included.
notes: powder is dominant US form; dried leaf listed separately

name: Herbal smoking blend
definition: loose non-tobacco herbal mixture sold for smoking (provisional until attested, B-31).
notes: loose tobacco-free blend for pipe or rolling

name: Salvia
definition: dried salvia divinorum leaf or extract taken for a psychoactive effect (K-168; provisional until attested).
notes: dried leaves and extracts sold in Dutch smart shops

name: Shisha tobacco
definition: moist, usually flavoured tobacco for smoking in a hookah.
notes: shisha tobacco by brand, flavour and size

name: Tobacco-free shisha
definition: shisha of non-tobacco material for the hookah, filed with the form it imitates.
notes: steam stones as tobacco-free substitute for hookah tobacco

name: Heating stick
definition: tobacco or tobacco-free stick made to be heated, not burned, in a heated-tobacco device.
notes: TEREA sticks for IQOS ILUMA; LEVIA tobacco-free sticks; Ploom sticks

name: Capsule-type heated product
definition: heated product in which vapour passes through a tobacco capsule.
notes: with: tobacco capsule product for Ploom Tech Plus

name: Chewing tobacco
definition: loose leaf, plug or twist tobacco made for chewing.
notes: loose leaf, plug, twist, pellets, sticks

name: Dry snuff
definition: finely ground dry tobacco taken through the nose.

name: Moist snuff [dip]
definition: moist ground tobacco placed between lip and gum.

name: Loose snus
definition: moist, unportioned snus.

name: Original portion snus
definition: snus in moist portion bags.

name: White portion snus
definition: snus in drier, lighter portion bags.

name: Dissolvable
definition: tobacco product made to dissolve in the mouth.
notes: Camel strips, sticks, orbs; Ariva; Stonewall

name: Nicotine pouch
definition: tobacco-free portion pouch holding nicotine.

name: Nicotine pearl
definition: small tobacco-free nicotine bead for the mouth.
notes: nicotine pearls category named on VPZ page

name: Betel quid
definition: areca nut with additions wrapped in betel leaf, sold for chewing (provisional until attested, B-31).
notes: commercial betel quid in tins or sachets

name: Areca nut
definition: areca nut sold for chewing (provisional until attested, B-31).

name: Khat
definition: khat leaf sold for chewing (provisional until attested, B-31).
notes: fresh khat leaves chewed; miraa and muguka

name: Freebase e-liquid
definition: e-liquid with freebase nicotine.

name: Nic-salt e-liquid
definition: e-liquid with nicotine salt.

name: Zero-nicotine e-liquid
definition: e-liquid without nicotine, shortfill bottles included.

name: Prefilled pod
definition: sealed pod filled with e-liquid for a pod device.

name: Prefilled vape cartridge
definition: filled cartridge for a vape pen, the substance (nicotine or cannabinoid) being the tag.

name: Kief
definition: loose resin glands sifted from cannabis.

name: Ice water hash
definition: resin glands separated with ice water and collected as hash.

name: Rosin
definition: resin pressed from cannabis with heat and pressure, without solvent.

name: Shatter
definition: solvent-extracted concentrate set as a brittle glassy sheet.

name: Badder [wax]
definition: solvent-extracted concentrate whipped to a soft, waxy texture.
notes: Weedmaps Badder; Leafly Badder and Wax as separate categories

name: Live resin
definition: solvent extract made from fresh-frozen cannabis.

name: Distillate
definition: refined cannabinoid oil distilled to high purity.

name: Edible
definition: food item infused with a cannabinoid, kratom or other B9 substance (gummies, chocolates, baked goods, mints).

name: Drink
definition: beverage infused with a cannabinoid, kratom or other B9 substance, shots included.

name: Tincture
definition: liquid extract taken by drops, CBD oil included.

name: Capsule or tablet
definition: dosed capsule or tablet of a cannabinoid, kratom or other B9 substance.

name: Topical
definition: balm, lotion or cream containing a cannabinoid, applied to the skin.
